title: Per-tenant site Section cyclotron
description: The site cyclotron derives its classifiers from Section ids, so with per-tenant Sections it must be per tenant: the cyclotron id, store path, Assignment and decision records are scoped by tenant, and the Section list comes from that tenant's NewsroomSections. Gherkin: Given two tenants with different Sections, when each runs the site sweep, then each has its own cyclotron with only its own Sections.
